en.overview: Plan corn nutrition around local conditions, crop goals and the four main stages of growth.
en.stages: Establishment · vegetative growth · flowering or fruiting · quality and harvest
en.stagesText: Use these stages to structure observations, compare product formats and prepare a focused product conversation.
en.nutrition: Start with soil and water analysis, then compare the nutrient roles and package formats described on the related product pages. Final rates should follow local agronomic advice.
en.products: Open the brochure-linked product pages to compare categories, package information and source pages.
en.resourcesText: Use the source page references on each product page and contact the KOMU team for current technical documents.

zh.overview: 结合当地种植条件、作物目标和主要生长阶段规划玉米营养。
zh.stages: 定植与建苗 · 营养生长 · 开花或结果 · 品质与采收
zh.stagesText: 用四个阶段整理观察记录、比较产品形态，并准备更有针对性的产品沟通。
zh.nutrition: 先结合土壤和水质分析，再对照关联产品页面中的营养作用和包装形式。具体用量应结合当地农艺建议。
zh.products: 打开画册关联产品页面，比较产品类别、包装信息和来源页码。
zh.resourcesText: 可查看产品页面中的来源页码，并通过联系方式向康姆团队获取最新技术资料。
